'''"Who Are You To Accuse Me?"''' was a popular [[Holo-series|holo entertainment series]] produced by [[Millennium Holos]]<ref name="HSCS" /> and released by [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> A promotional screening of the holo-series hosting high-level executives occurred in [[Mondder]],<ref name="Gunslingers">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> a city<ref name="Agent">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="HSCS" /> [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. During this screening, a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attack by the [[Duroon Rebels]] allowed [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]] [[Uul-Rha-Shan]] to take advantage of the situation, saving the [[Assistant Advisory Undersecretary of Media]] in front of [[Galaxy News Service]] [[Camera/Legends|cameras]], bringing to him great fame.<ref name="Gunslingers" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Who Are You To Accuse Me?" was first mentioned in ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Michael Allen Horne]].<ref name="HSCS" />
